source_text: Elevantes filii Istrahel de Ramesse venerunt in Soccoth. Ramesses — tumultus tinearum / malitia saeculi; Soccoth — tabernacula. Exeuntes de tumultu ad peregrinationis tentoria tendimus.
pass_a_gloss: Lifting-up sons of-Israel from Rameses came into Succoth. Rameses — tumult of-moths / malice of-age; Succoth — tents. Exiting from tumult to of-sojourning tents we-stretch.
pass_b_english: [[The children of Israel set out from Rameses and came to Succoth >> Bible:Exodus 12:37]]. Leave the world’s noisy “Rameses” and pitch Succoth’s tents — the life of sojourners who no longer settle in Egypt’s brickworks.
